name: Loading
rows: Bubble March is a board game Little Mermaid created using bubbles.
Summon heroes and minions to fight against the invading Raptures.
Different minions have an advantage against different types of Raptures. Please refer to the description of the minions.
Summon Bubbles automatically refill over time and can also be obtained by defeating Raptures.
Summon Bubbles can be used to upgrade heroes and minions.
New heroes and minions can be unlocked through research.
Traits provide more advantages in battles.
Learn the hero's unique trait to use powerful skills.
Research and traits can be reset.
Each stage has first clear rewards and repeatable rewards.
If the stage is too difficult, try upgrading the traits.
